ingestion.identity_policy: Case-folded normalized name plus normalized endpoint; product paths/subdomains preserved; aliases not merged.
ingestion.metric_policy: Nonnegative integer metrics only; blanks are missing; invalid values excluded from totals and counted.
ingestion.source_row_policy: 1-based data-record index, excluding header; join to original records using this index.
ingestion.event_policy: All accepted records count; no duplicate event-ID removal.
ingestion.scope: Extraction only; no AI labels or categories assigned.
